**Daily Devotional**

**May 7**

*20 I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me. 21 I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain. (Galatians 2:20-21 KJV)*

Note that this verse says that Paul lives by the faith OF the Son of God, not faith IN. God’s faith comes by hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17). We humans could not even believe to be saved with our own faith, but we had to have God’s faith to be able to believe for salvation (Ephesians 2:8).

Most Christians believe they need more faith, and pray many times for God to give them more faith. That is not so, as we have been given THE measure of faith (Romans 12:3), which is the faith of Jesus Christ. This faith is part of the Fruit of the Spirit that we all have been given upon being born again (Galatians 5:22-23). Since we all have this faith, the same faith that Peter had (2 Peter 1:1), it is available for us to use, as we are able to tap into the Spirit that lives within us. We all need to be as Paul was, and be dead to ourselves, and alive unto Christ, and live the Godly life that we were meant to live (1 Peter 1:15). This is only done by walking in the Spirit, and not in the flesh, by renewing our minds with the Word of God (Romans 12:2). Let us all live for Jesus every day, in every way – Praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
